opening.argument: The creator presents flash-loan arbitrage as a repeatable way to turn about $200 into $1,496, while claiming the method has been working for months. The description promotes returns of “up to 100 times your investment” and supplies smart-contract code links. Viewers are then instructed to copy the code, create a contract, connect MetaMask, and fund it with roughly 230 MATIC for gas. This is a concrete request to deploy and fund a contract in pursuit of the promoted returns, not reporting or testing a third-party scheme. The speaker also ties putting value into the contract and trading the coin to the expected profit.
